title: Two-sided split-calculus parametrices for fibered-boundary Hodge Laplacians with commuting harmonic projection and base dimension at least two
source_title: Spectral geometry on manifolds with fibered boundary metrics I: Low energy resolvent
author: Daniel Grieser; Mohammad Talebi; Boris Vertman
difficulty_reason: A scalar elliptic parametrix does not control the different harmonic and perpendicular boundary asymptotics of the fibered-boundary Laplacian. Section5 introduces an extended fiber-diagonal calculus, constructs the block approximation and corrects its indicial behavior before removing the enlarged interior singularity. The source then iterates to the exact left/right remainder classes, retaining the specified index sets after standard pseudodifferential foundations are allowed.

proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. Theorem5.4 only, for conjugated Hodge Laplacian square_phi on compact smooth manifold with closed fibered boundary, smooth metric perturbation O(x³), Riemannian submersion, commuting D_B/harmonic projection and base dimension b>=2. Every weight alpha outside real indicial spectrum has two-sided split-calculus parametrix with exact displayed index family and opposite infinite-order remainders. Selected theorem does not require full Assumption1.4 spectral gap [-1,1]; weight avoidance is its explicit condition. Full split structure20–25, new index-family definitions26–27, extended-calculus lift facts27–28 and all four proof steps28–32 read. Prior Melrose b-calculus/Mazzeo–Melrose phi-calculus and GH14 extended composition are explicit previously established research foundations. This strengthened domain-and-range asymptotic version retains independent new closure detail (Remark5.5), not an additional corollary. Source32 prints R_alpha=R3(Id+S) inconsistent with immediately supplied asymptotic inverse Id+S; remainder identity follows by its explicitly specified multiplication/telescoping, a bounded algebraic notation slip. No independent parametrix construction supplied. Not selecting ancillary claim that two leading orders agree with Q1, full low-energy resolvent, Fredholm inverse or no-resonance corollary.
